# @skillship/min-example-sdk

Auto-generated TypeScript SDK for min.example.

## Install

```sh
npm install @skillship/min-example-sdk
```

## Usage

```ts
import { Client } from "@skillship/min-example-sdk";

const client = new Client({
  baseUrl: "https://api.min.example",
  auth: { kind: "bearer", token: process.env.API_TOKEN! },
});
```
